notes.title: The strongest enemy quest, "Dark Insects Guldus," appears!
notes.content:
You can now battle against the powerful enemy quest "Dark Mushroom Gardas".

[How to play]
From the item code entry facility, head to the special quest site and
Let's talk to the Purifier.

* Item Code Entry Facility (Example)
- Dakti ferry port
- Cyhum Institute
- Capital City of D.H.

There is no penalty for challenge or defeat.
